vector_memory.semantic_summary: This component defines the custom exception class GpuMemoryError, serving as a critical error contract for the LLM loading service. Its sole responsibility is to encapsulate and communicate failures specifically related to GPU memory allocation constraints during model loading. It allows higher-level logic to diagnose root causes such as insufficient VRAM by providing structured diagnostic data via its attributes. This pattern enforces clean separation between loading mechanics and application error handling.
